video_goal: Demonstrate how to efficiently pack a carry-on suitcase by wrapping clothes into a bundle and compressing them inside an eBags compression cube.
required_subjects_and_props: Jeans, t-shirts, small pouch of socks (core), eBags compression cube, carry-on suitcase, bed or flat packing surface.

outline_steps.visual_action: Hands lay a pair of jeans completely flat on a bed, smoothing out the wrinkles along the legs.
Hands place a t-shirt flat on top of the jeans, aligning the collars and sleeves in opposite directions to form a cross shape.
Hands place a small, tightly rolled pouch of socks directly in the center of the layered clothes to act as the bundle's core.
Hands fold the sleeves and bottom hem of the t-shirt tightly over the central sock pouch, wrapping it completely.
Hands fold the legs of the jeans tightly over the wrapped t-shirt layer, creating a single, compact, solid clothing bundle.
Hands open an empty eBags compression cube, folding back the branded mesh top lid to reveal the interior.
Hands lift the completed clothing bundle and place it snugly inside the open eBags compression cube.
Fingers pull the main top zipper of the eBags cube closed, securing the mesh lid over the clothing bundle.
Fingers grip the secondary outer compression zipper on the eBags cube and begin pulling it along the side edge.
Hands press down firmly on the top of the mesh cube while pulling the compression zipper all the way around, visibly flattening the cube.
Hands lift the flattened, compressed eBags cube and place it into the open main compartment of a carry-on suitcase.
Hands buckle the internal tie-down straps of the carry-on suitcase over the eBags cube and pull the strap tight.
